text.tspan: Loving Christ for the Kingdom Reward
The Kingdom — As an Exercise and a Reward
Jesus rests with His dear loved ones;
On Christ’s head the flask is emptied,
Fragrance of a life not spared.
Though some mocked her sweet burnt offering,
We’d like Mary hold back nothing;
Toward the Kingdom let us race.
Praise our Christ whose steps we follow,
On our Lord of Hosts depend.
Christ is coming soon to conquer;
From the cloud He will descend.
Every day our heart must seek Him,
For this age one day will end.
Patterns in the price they paid;
Still their faithful labor guides us,
Each his soul not loved or spared,
May we earn our crown of glory
